scope_comparison: The October theorem's 2n−1 budget and27n bound would numerically imply the target, but its admissible randomized algorithms require decision rules and reconstruction jointly measurable on finite-dimensional affine slices. The local problem only requires scalar-error measurability. No extension or bridge for the broader local class was located; the exact target is not marked solved.
